description: This file defines the EmployeeJobController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It manages employee job-related views, fetching various services to prepare data and properties for rendering the employee job component, including job titles, categories, employment statuses, subunits, locations, and termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeJobController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee job information, fetching necessary data through various services, and setting up properties for the employee-job component.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the JobCategoryService instance.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the CompanyStructureService instance.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmploymentStatusService instance.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LocationService instance.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the employee job component based on the employee number, including setting component properties with job titles, categories, statuses, subunits, locations, and termination reasons.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups for capability checks, here including 'job_details'.
